hints.title: Farthest point
hints.body: Track the farthest marker you could possibly reach rather than every individual path.

hints.title: Blocked index
hints.body: Scan left to right. If the current index is beyond the farthest reachable index, the end cannot be reached.

hints.title: Update before moving
hints.body: At index `i`, extend the farthest reachable index to at least `i + steps[i]`.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
farthest = 0
last = length(steps) - 1
for i from 0 to last:
    if i > farthest:
        return false
    farthest = max(farthest, i + steps[i])
    if farthest >= last:
        return true
return true
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
